      protected void testCraftingMachinesInNetwork(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, boolean attuned, net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block[] crafters, int expectedInterfaces, net.minecraft.world.item.Item expectedMachine, net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.RecipeType<?> recipeType, net.minecraft.resources.Identifier recipeName)

      Parameters:

      attuned - If an attuned crafting interface should be used.
